definitions.explanation: The state of being similar or alike in appearance, form, or nature. Used in both everyday and technical (especially mathematical) contexts.

definitions.gloss: similarity (in geometry); having the same shape but different size
definitions.explanation: A mathematical term describing geometric figures that have the same shape but may differ in scale. Two figures are similar if their corresponding angles are equal and sides are proportional.

notes:
A compound of {相|そう} (mutual) + {似|じ} (resemble). Used across registers from everyday description to mathematical terminology.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {相似|そうじ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧: to resemble each other
- {相似|そうじ}⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧: point of similarity
- {相似|そうじ}{形|けい}: similar figure (geometry)
- {相似|そうじ}⟦{比|ひ}→比：30310_hi⟧: similarity ratio

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{類似|るいじ}→類似：14672_ruiji⟧: similarity — the more common general term for resemblance between things
- ⟦{似|に}ている→似る：01159_niru⟧: to resemble — the everyday verb for looking alike
- ⟦{酷似|こくじ}→酷似：19943_kokuji⟧: striking resemblance — emphasizes very close similarity
- ⟦{合同|ごうどう}→合同：04185_goudou⟧: congruence (geometry) — same shape AND same size
